Independently test the assigned ordinary-language keyword cumulonimbus convective storm structure in one randomized, complex, photorealistic environmental portrait, using the supplied image only for visible adult appearance continuity and making the storm anatomy the primary legible subject.

Create a photorealistic wide environmental portrait on a rain-darkened cracked dry-lake basin at sunset. A full cumulonimbus convective storm structure dominates the photograph: a dark, low cloud base; an immense vertically billowing tower; a broad, flattened anvil; and a distant opaque precipitation shaft. The gust front is visibly sweeping rain mist and dust across the cracked basin. In the lower-left foreground, an unmistakably adult environmental reporter with long dark softly waved hair braces into the wind, holding a closed field notebook against a weatherproof ochre coat. Render visible general facial appearance continuity from the supplied appearance reference, understood as resemblance rather than identity. Frame at 28 mm from a low eye-level viewpoint; the person occupies about twelve percent of the image and leaves the storm base, tower, anvil, and rain shaft unobstructed. Amber sunset light rims the reporter and wet clay while blue-black cloud shadows hold the immense sky. Emphasize physically coherent scale, turbulent cloud texture, wind-driven surface motion, and a readable transition from clear foreground air into the storm's outflow.
